name: Kerala
intro: Backwaters and houseboats of Alappuzha and Kumarakom, the tea hills of Munnar, Periyar and Silent Valley, colonial Fort Kochi, Varkala's cliffs and Kovalam, Theyyam and Kathakali, Thrissur Pooram, and the forts and beaches of Malabar.
